title: Samsonite Proxis Global Carry-On Spinner — Silver

comparisons.notes: Silver model 1418451776 in stock at $500. Conservative $450 comparison includes the advertised extra 10% TREAT10 discount; coupon was not checkout-tested.

writeup: This silver Proxis is a compact spinner with a listed 22-by-14-by-9-inch exterior and a 4.7-pound weight. Woot’s $129.99 is 71% below a conservative $450 comparison that allows for Samsonite’s advertised extra 10% discount on its $500 price. The main tradeoff is warranty coverage: Woot lists 90 days, while Samsonite’s direct listing advertises a longer manufacturer warranty.
notes: Check your airline’s size rules, including wheels and handles. The TREAT10 comparison is an advertised coupon calculation, not a completed checkout; eligibility or expiration may change.
